claim: Patchline ships a verified incremental-analysis algorithm proven equivalent to a full re-analysis. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the equivalent to a full re-analysis claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make verified-incremental-analysis-gate`.
